title: Interdisciplinary Pathways towards Green and Resilient Societies
summary: An online partner exchange on the green transition and climate resilience, linking social sciences and humanities with STEM fields.
details: It is meant for people preparing Horizon Europe proposals in health, climate and environment, energy, mobility and cities. Participants get an overview of selected 2027 topics, practical advice on integrating social sciences and humanities, and chances to find partners.
why: Many topics expect real social sciences and humanities input, and it is often the last partner a consortium finds. This event is a direct way to close that gap.
source_name: Czech National Agency for International Education and Research (DZS)
